sentences.q: My broken leg is gradually ______.
sentences.full: My broken leg is gradually healing.
sentences.exp: 我骨折的腿正在慢慢癒合。(heal:（使身體或心理）傷口痊癒)

sentences.q: They said the rebels had a stronghold deep in the ______.
sentences.full: They said the rebels had a stronghold deep in the jungle.
sentences.exp: 他們說叛軍在叢林深處有一個據點。(jungle:叢林)

sentences.q: The construction workers were busy ______ the road.
sentences.full: The construction workers were busy paving the road.
sentences.exp: 施工人員正忙著鋪路。(pave:鋪（路）)

sentences.q: The young man drew his ______ and challenged the knight.
sentences.full: The young man drew his sword and challenged the knight.
sentences.exp: 那位年輕人拔出劍,向騎士挑戰。(sword:劍)

sentences.q: The bank robber was ______ with only a knife.
sentences.full: The bank robber was armed with only a knife.
sentences.exp: 那名銀行搶匪只帶著一把刀當武器。(armed:武裝的)

sentences.q: Have you ever visited the Grand ______ in Arizona?
sentences.full: Have you ever visited the Grand Canyon in Arizona?
sentences.exp: 你去過亞利桑那州的大峽谷嗎?(canyon:峽谷)

sentences.q: Paula tripped on her shoelaces and ______ her ankle.
sentences.full: Paula tripped on her shoelaces and sprained her ankle.
sentences.exp: 寶拉被鞋帶絆倒,扭傷了腳踝。(sprain:扭傷)

sentences.q: Global markets took a ______ last night after the election results.
sentences.full: Global markets took a dive last night after the election results.
sentences.exp: 選舉結果出爐後,全球市場昨晚大跌。(dive:暴跌)

sentences.q: ______ are my grandmother’s favorite flowers.
sentences.full: Violets are my grandmother’s favorite flowers.
sentences.exp: 紫羅蘭是我奶奶最愛的花。(violet:紫羅蘭)

sentences.q: ______ engines were developed in the 18th century.
sentences.full: Steam engines were developed in the 18th century.
sentences.exp: 蒸汽機是在十八世紀發展出來的。(steam:水蒸氣)
